recognize_zh: 高倍鏡下可見粗厚且形狀不規則的骨小樑，邊緣有扇貝狀凹陷，骨髓腔完全被含梭形細胞與小血管的疏鬆纖維血管組織取代、沒有造血細胞，是 Paget 骨病骨髓的表現。
features: Thick, irregularly shaped bony trabeculae with scalloped, notched surfaces
Osteocytes within lacunae; faint irregular cement lines in places
Marrow spaces replaced by loose, vacuolated fibrovascular stroma with bland spindle and stellate cells and small capillaries
Absent hematopoietic cells and fat in the marrow spaces
Osteoclasts not conspicuous in this field; no atypical or tumor cells
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow trephine shows thick, irregular trabeculae with scalloped surfaces containing osteocytes in lacunae. The marrow spaces are entirely replaced by loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue with bland spindle cells and small capillaries, and hematopoietic elements are absent. Osteoclasts are not prominent in this particular field, and no malignant cells are identified. Findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone, correlating with the sclerotic lesions and elevated alkaline phosphatase.

ddx.vs: Prostate metastases contain glands or cords of epithelial cells positive for keratin, PSA and NKX3.1 within the stroma, absent here.
Myelofibrosis retains atypical clustered megakaryocytes and dilated sinusoids with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, not a bland vascular connective tissue.
Renal osteodystrophy shows tunneling resorption, osteoid seams and peritrabecular fibrosis with chronic kidney disease.
